name: Streax Professionals Vitariche Care Repair Max Shampoo for Dry to Damaged Hair 300ml | Made in BD
description:
Streax Professional Vitariche Care Repair Max Shampoo – 300ml
For Dry to Damaged Hair | Made in Bangladesh

Revitalize and repair dry, damaged hair with Streax Professional Vitariche Care Repair Max Shampoo. Infused with the Biovit-A-OX Complex—a blend of Biotin, Vitamin B5, and Vitamin E—this shampoo nourishes, strengthens, and protects hair from damage caused by environmental factors, heat, and chemical treatments.

Key Features & Benefits:

Repairs & Rejuvenates Hair: Hydrolyzed flax protein and ceramide mimic molecules help restore rough, damaged hair.

Reduces Hair Breakage: Up to 14x less breakage and significantly improves tensile strength.

Smooth & Soft Hair: Minimizes cuticle lifting for softer, smoother, and more manageable strands.

Hydrating & Nourishing: Helps reduce split ends and replenishes moisture for healthier-looking hair.

High-Quality Professional Care: Designed to deliver salon-quality results at home.

Size: 300ml
Target Hair Type: Dry to Damaged Hair
Country of Origin: Bangladesh

Bring back the shine, strength, and smoothness of your hair with Streax Professional Vitariche Care Repair Max Shampoo, part of the advanced Vitariche Care range.
